run-en.text: To a solution of {{C1}} ({{s1.C1.mg}}, {{s1.C1.mmol}}, {{s1.C1.equiv}}), {{C2}} ({{s1.C2.mg}}, {{s1.C2.mmol}}, {{s1.C2.equiv}}), and {{s1.R2}} ({{s1.R2.mg}}, {{s1.R2.mmol}}, {{s1.R2.equiv}}) in {{s1.M1}} ({{s1.M1.amount}}) at 20 °C was added {{s1.R1}} ({{s1.R1.mg}}, {{s1.R1.mmol}}, {{s1.R1.equiv}}) in four portions (exothermic, internal temperature 2 to 6 °C). The mixture was stirred at 21 °C until the reaction was complete as confirmed by HPLC. The organic layer was washed with {{s1.M2}} ({{s1.M2.amount}}) (aqueous layer pH 1) at 20 °C, {{s1.M3}} ({{s1.M3.amount}}) (aqueous layer pH 8) at 21 °C, and {{s1.M4}} ({{s1.M4.amount}}). The solution was concentrated under reduced pressure at an internal temperature of 35 °C. The residue was dissolved in {{s1.M5}} ({{s1.M5.amount}}), and {{s1.M6}} ({{s1.M6.amount}}) was added while cooling from 45 to 5 °C (crystallization began at 25 °C). The precipitate was collected by filtration at 5 °C, washed with heptane, and dried under reduced pressure at 40 °C for 16 h to give {{C3}} ({{s1.C3.mg}}, {{s1.C3.mmol}}, {{s1.yield}}).
